title: KYA ZULM THE FARZANDE HUSSAIN IBNE ALI PAR ZANJEER BHI RONE LAGI AABID SE LIPAT KAR
body:
Sar kat'te hi Baba ka qayamat huwi barpa
Thi aag lagi khaimo'n me ek hashr bapa tha
Ghash me the pade Abide Beemar zami'n par
<<MINI>>
Kya zulm the Farzande Hussain Ibne Ali par
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya kya na sahe ranjo sitam Abide Dilgeer
Zakhmo'n se lahu behta tha jab hilti thi zanjeer
Koi na taras khaata tha hanste the sitamgar
<<MINI>>
Kya zulm the Farzande Hussain Ibne Ali par
<<DIVIDER>>
Jhoola Ali Asghar ka jhulaste huwe dekha
Chaadar Sar-e Zainab se utarte huwe dekha
Is zulm pa bhi sabr kiya Allah o Akbar
<<MINI>>
Kya zulm the Farzande Hussain Ibne Ali par
<<DIVIDER>>
Mazloom Sakina ki bhi turbat hai banayi
Maa deti rahi Laash pa ro ro ke duhaayi
Dafna ne ko behna ke kafan tha na muyyasar
<<MINI>>
Kya zulm the Farzande Hussain Ibne Ali par
<<DIVIDER>>
Bas Shaam ka naam aate hiHojaate the Muztar
Maa Behne'nPhupi saath thi'n be maqna 0 chaadar
Kehte the na Bhoolunga kabhi shaam ka manzar
<<MINI>>
Kya zulm the Farzande Hussain Ibne Ali par
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba se jo waada tha Usse kardiya poora
Wo sabr kiya sabr bhi aajiz nazar aaya
Mazloomi ke sadge Tere Aye Shah ke Dilbar
<<MINI>>
Kya zulm the Farzande Hussain Ibne Ali par
<<DIVIDER>>
Khwahar ko tamaanche lage par lab na hilaya
Hamsheer tadapti rahi jalta raha seena
Aur saamne Masooma ke bhi chhin gaye gohar
<<MINI>>
Kya zulm the Farzande Hussain Ibne Ali par
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Moosavi duniya se utha aaj wo Ghamkhwaar
Chaalees baras Roya tha Sheh ka jo Azadaar
Maatam issi Mazloom ka hai aaj har ek ghar
<<MINI>>
Kya zulm the Farzande Hussain Ibne Ali par
author: Syed Mustafa Moosavi
